answer: Charge every new identity a glacier toll: the registry keeps a slow ledger of past registrations, and the fee for the next identity is $2 times one plus identities minted in the last ten epochs over fifty. A lone honest agent pays $2 once at the base ledge, while an attacker minting 1,000 puppets in one burst climbs the ridge: the 1,000th puppet costs $42, and the whole batch totals $22,020. No bulk discount: each puppet pays the ridge height it reaches, and the glacier ledger resets only at epoch close, so timing tricks cannot dodge the climb.
